items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: We thought this fella came along and he was so good, it, uh, we didn't want to replace Fate, so we just put two of them on.

ctx.x: I guess many people had it then. I can't think of any bands that were featured. No, they didn't have it.

When we had it the first time, and, uh, it was just an idea. We thought this fella came along and he was so good, it, uh, we didn't want to replace Fate, so we just put two of them on. So we had, uh, double cameras. Mm-hmm .
